rule.title: Prizes And Odds - Keno | Delaware Lottery
bonusRows: Overall Probability of Winning any Multiplier
sourceStatements: You can win in a variety of ways — by matching some, all or in some cases, none of the numbers you've chosen. KENO® gives you the chance to win up to $100,000 per drawing and KENO® Bonus gives you the chance to win up to $1,000,000 per drawing!*
See the prize chart for details. Payouts are based on a $1 per game wager. To determine other amounts, simply multiply the prize payout amount stated by the dollar amounts played.
For information on how to claim your KENO® prize, visit Delaware Lottery's How to Claim Prizes page.
$100,000** is the maximum prize that can be paid on any single KENO® (without bonus) wager. All win levels for KENO® without bonus shall be capped at $100,000.
$1,000,000** is the maximum prize that can be paid on any single KENO® (with bonus) wager. All win levels for Keno with bonus shall be capped at $900,000.
**These are the maximum prizes per ticket, regardless of the spots selected, amount wagered or bonus number drawn.

For any single KENO® drawing, there is a maximum liability pool of $1,000,000 that may be used to pay on all Top Prize winning wagers with bonus (wagers that win $1,000,000). For any given single KENO® drawing, if there are more than two Top Prize winners, the maximum liability of $1,000,000 shall be divided equally among each of the Top Prize winning wagers. For any single KENO® drawing, there is a maximum liability pool of $100,000 that may be used to pay on all Top Prize winning wagers without bonus (wagers that win $100,000). For any given single KENO® drawing, if there are more than two Top Prize winners, the maximum liability of $100,000 shall be divided equally among each of the Top Prize winning wagers.

qualifications: Overall odds are 1 in 7.8, based on $2.00 play. Purchasers must be 18 or older.
TOP PRIZE 5+1

(1) Minimum top prize period is 20 years. Top prize winners may choose the Cash Option as an alternative to the Annuitized Payment Option. Top prize amount shown is based on one winning ticket. Top prize values governed by "split-prize" liability; the top prize is divided equally among the top prize winning tickets and may be less than shown.
1 top prize winning ticket: The prize value is $1,000 a day for life ($7,000 a week for life).
2-14 top prize winning tickets: The prize value is split equally among the winning tickets; the minimum prize value for this category is $500 a week for life.

15 or more top prize winning tickets: The top prize liability of $7,125,000 is split equally among all top prize winning tickets and paid in one lump sum payment. The minimum prize value for this category shall not be less than any lower tier prize paid in that respective drawing.
SECOND PRIZE 5+0

(2) Minimum second prize payment period is 20 years. Second prize winners may choose the Cash Option as an alternative to the Annuitized Payment Option. Second prize amount shown is based on one to twenty winning tickets. Second prize values governed by "split-prize" liability; second prize is divided equally among all the second prize winning tickets and may be less than shown.
1-20 second prize winning tickets: The annuitized prize value will be $25,000 a year for life.

21 or more second prize winning tickets: The second prize liability of $9,400,000 is split equally among all second prize winning tickets and paid in one lump sum payment. The minimum prize value shall not be less than any lower tier prize paid in that respective drawing.
THIRD PRIZE 4+1

(3) $5,000 prize value is guaranteed to 1,000 winning tickets. If the number of winning tickets exceeds 1,000 the total prize liability of $5,000,000 is divided equally among the winning tickets. The minimum prize value for this category is $200.
All prizes are rounded to the nearest whole dollar.
Special rules apply to multiple winners that are not natural persons; see Official Lucky for Life Game Rules.
